# Project: OpenFlightReader Phase 1 (Core Library Implementation)

## Architecture
- Target Crate: `crates/flightreader-core`
- Rust Workspace: Root `Cargo.toml` with virtual workspace membership
- Architecture: Zero-allocation slice-based binary parsing, pure register cryptographic key derivation, robust error taxonomy via `thiserror`, panic-free stream iterator framing.
- Output Deliverables:
  - `crates/flightreader-core/`: Production-grade library crate.
  - `crates/flightreader-core/src/lib.rs`: Public API facade and prelude.
  - `crates/flightreader-core/src/error.rs`: Contextual error enum (`FlightReaderError`).
  - `crates/flightreader-core/src/txt/`: DJI .txt binary header & version capabilities parser (`header.rs`, `version.rs`, `mod.rs`).
  - `crates/flightreader-core/src/crypto/`: ECMA-182 CRC64 engine & cyclic XOR de-scrambler (`crc64.rs`, `xor.rs`, `mod.rs`).
  - `crates/flightreader-core/src/dat/`: Blackbox frame synchronization & CRC16/CRC32 verification (`frame.rs`, `checksum.rs`, `mod.rs`).
  - `crates/flightreader-core/tests/`: Integration & property test suites (`txt_header_tests.rs`, `crypto_crc64_tests.rs`, `dat_framing_tests.rs`, `property_tests.rs`).

## Feature Inventory
| # | Feature | Description | Milestone | Source |
|---|---------|-------------|-----------|--------|
| 1 | Cargo Workspace & Core Crate Setup | Root virtual workspace `Cargo.toml`, `crates/flightreader-core/Cargo.toml`, dependencies (`thiserror`, `byteorder`, `proptest`, `criterion`), release optimizations (`lto="fat"`, `panic="abort"`), module scaffolding, `FlightReaderError` | M1 | spec_miner_p1_2 |
| 2 | DJI .txt Binary Header Parser | Parse `DetailsOffset` (0..7 i64 LE), `HeaderLength` (8..9 i16 LE), `Version` (10 u8), `Department` (11 u8), `ScrambledFlag` (12 u8), `Reserved` (13..99), `HeaderPadding` (100 u8 if len==101); boundary and validation checks | M2 | spec_miner_p1_1, spec_miner_p1_2 |
| 3 | DJI .txt Version Capabilities Matrix | Classify v1 through v14 capabilities: length field width (1B in v1..6 vs 2B in v7..14), scrambling type (none, XOR, AES), details offset relocation | M2 | spec_miner_p1_1 |
| 4 | ECMA-182 CRC64 Lookup Table Engine | 256-element lookup table based on polynomial `0x42F0E1EBA9EA3693`, bit-exact match with `FlightReader.Sharp.Crc64` and `SPECS.md` | M3 | spec_miner_p1_1, explorer_p1_3 |
| 5 | 64-bit CRC64 Key Derivation | Magic constant `1311768467463790320` (`0x123456789ABCDEF0`), seed formula `(seed + record_type) % 256`, reverse iteration, little-endian 8-byte key derivation across all 256 seeds and record types | M3 | spec_miner_p1_1, explorer_p1_3 |
| 6 | Cyclic XOR De-Scrambling Engine | Cyclic 8-byte keystream expansion, zero-allocation in-place `descramble_in_place`, buffered `descramble_slice`, and allocating `descramble_to_vec` | M3 | spec_miner_p1_1, spec_miner_p1_2 |
| 7 | DJI .DAT Blackbox 0x55 Stream Framing | Stream synchronization on `0x55` magic byte, 9-byte header extraction (magic, length, sequence, payload_id, timestamp_ticks), payload extraction `[9..length - checksum_len]` | M4 | spec_miner_p1_1, spec_miner_p1_2 |
| 8 | DJI .DAT Checksum Verification | CRC16-CCITT (poly `0x1021`, init `0x3692`) and standard IEEE 802.3 CRC32 verification, rejecting corrupted frame candidates | M4 | spec_miner_p1_1, explorer_p1_3 |
| 9 | Zero-Allocation .DAT Stream Frame Iterator | `DatFrameIterator<'a>` zero-copy iterator yielding `DatFrame<'a>` over `&'a [u8]`, handling noise recovery and resynchronization | M4 | spec_miner_p1_2, explorer_p1_3 |
| 10 | Exhaustive Unit & Integration Test Suite | Bit-exact CRC64 key vectors (72 reference vectors), 256-seed full roundtrip verification, synthetic headers (v1..v14, 100B/101B), corrupted .DAT streams and 77B noise stream recovery | M5 | explorer_p1_3 |
| 11 | Property-Based & Robustness Testing | `proptest` suites verifying involutive XOR property ($A \oplus K \oplus K = A$), keystream periodicity, and panic-free parsing across fuzzed inputs | M5 | explorer_p1_3 |
| 12 | Final Integration, Build & Audit Verification | 100% test pass via `cargo test`, zero compiler warnings (`cargo check`, `cargo clippy`), zero integrity violations via forensic audit | M6 | sentinel |

## Milestones
| # | Name | Scope | Dependencies | Status |
|---|------|-------|-------------|--------|
| M1 | Workspace Setup & Core Crate Initialization | Root `Cargo.toml`, `crates/flightreader-core/Cargo.toml`, `src/lib.rs`, `src/error.rs`, module hierarchy, base types | Survey | PLANNED |
| M2 | DJI .txt Header & Version Parser | `src/txt/mod.rs`, `header.rs`, `version.rs`, validation logic, synthetic headers v1..v14 tests | M1 | PLANNED |
| M3 | CRC64 Keystream Engine & XOR De-Scrambler | `src/crypto/mod.rs`, `crc64.rs`, `xor.rs`, ECMA-182 table, 64-bit derivation, cyclic XOR, unit tests | M1 | PLANNED |
| M4 | Basic DJI .DAT Blackbox Framing | `src/dat/mod.rs`, `frame.rs`, `checksum.rs`, 0x55 sync, `DatFrameIterator`, CRC16/CRC32 verification | M1 | PLANNED |
| M5 | Comprehensive Test Suite & Property Tests | Integration tests in `tests/`, `proptest` suites, 256-seed matrix, noise stream recovery, clippy/fmt verification | M2, M3, M4 | PLANNED |
| M6 | Final Milestone & Forensic Audit Verification | Reviewers APPROVE, Challengers CONFIRM, Forensic Auditor CLEAN, Sentinel handoff | M5 | PLANNED |

## Interface Contracts

### Root Workspace ↔ `crates/flightreader-core`
- Workspace root members: `["crates/flightreader-core"]`
- Edition: 2021
- Dependencies: `thiserror = "2.0"` (or `"1.0"`), `byteorder = "1.5"`
- Dev-dependencies: `proptest = "1.5"`, `criterion = "0.5"`

### `flightreader_core::error::FlightReaderError`
- Variants:
  - `CorruptedHeader { expected_magic: Option<u8>, found: Option<u8>, reason: String }`
  - `InvalidHeaderLength { length: i16 }`
  - `UnsupportedVersion { version: u8 }`
  - `TruncatedRecord { expected: usize, available: usize }`
  - `InvalidRecordDelimiter { found: u8 }`
  - `PayloadTooShort { minimum: usize, available: usize }`
  - `BufferOverflow { required: usize, capacity: usize }`
  - `SyncNotFound`
  - `ChecksumMismatch { expected: u32, calculated: u32 }`
  - `InvalidFrameLength { length: u8, minimum: usize }`
  - `UnexpectedEof`

### `flightreader_core::txt`
- `TxtHeader::parse(input: &[u8]) -> Result<TxtHeader, FlightReaderError>`
  - `details_offset: i64`
  - `header_length: i16`
  - `version: u8`
  - `department: Department`
  - `scrambled_flag: u8`
  - `reserved: [u8; 87]`
  - `padding: Option<u8>`
- `TxtVersion::classify(version: u8) -> Result<VersionCapabilities, FlightReaderError>`

## Test Philosophy
- Opaque-box, requirement-driven. Derived from `ORIGINAL_REQUEST.md`, `SPECS.md`, and empirical validation vectors.
- Zero reliance on internal implementation details; exercise public library API and binary layout contracts directly.
- Methodology: Category-Partition + Boundary Value Analysis (BVA) + Combinatorial / Pairwise + Real-World Workload Testing + Property-Based Involutive Invariants.

## Feature Inventory & Test Coverage Goals
| # | Feature | Source | Tier 1 (Unit) | Tier 2 (Boundary) | Tier 3 (Cross-Feature) | Tier 4 (Workload) |
|---|---------|--------|:-------------:|:-----------------:|:----------------------:|:-----------------:|
| 1 | Workspace Setup & Error Handling | ORIGINAL_REQUEST §R1 | 5 | 5 | ✓ | ✓ |
| 2 | DJI .txt Binary Header Parser | ORIGINAL_REQUEST §R2 | 5 | 5 | ✓ | ✓ |
| 3 | DJI .txt Version Matrix (v1..v14) | SPECS.md §2.2 | 5 | 5 | ✓ | ✓ |
| 4 | ECMA-182 CRC64 Lookup Table | SPECS.md §3.2 | 5 | 5 | ✓ | ✓ |
| 5 | 64-bit CRC64 Key Derivation | SPECS.md §3.2 | 5 | 5 | ✓ | ✓ |
| 6 | Cyclic XOR De-Scrambling | SPECS.md §3.3 | 5 | 5 | ✓ | ✓ |
| 7 | DJI .DAT 0x55 Frame Synchronization | SPECS.md §6.2 | 5 | 5 | ✓ | ✓ |
| 8 | DJI .DAT Checksum Verification | SPECS.md §6.2 | 5 | 5 | ✓ | ✓ |
| 9 | Zero-Allocation DatFrameIterator | ARCHITECTURE ADR-001 | 5 | 5 | ✓ | ✓ |

## Test Architecture
- Test runner: `cargo test --all-targets --all-features`
- Integration tests directory: `crates/flightreader-core/tests/` and root `tests/`
- Test case format: Rust integration test functions with typed error assertions, bit-exact hex vector matches, and `proptest!` macros.
- Verification pass/fail semantics:
  - Exit code 0
  - Zero test failures
  - Zero compiler warnings (`cargo check`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`)
  - No panics on corrupted or truncated inputs

## Real-World Application Scenarios (Tier 4)
| # | Scenario | Features Exercised | Complexity |
|---|----------|--------------------|------------|
| 1 | Full 256-seed matrix OSD record de-scrambling | F4, F5, F6 | High |
| 2 | Multi-version .txt header batch parsing (v1 through v14 synthetic headers) | F2, F3 | Medium |
| 3 | Noisy .DAT blackbox byte stream with 77-byte noise stream recovery | F7, F8, F9 | High |

| 5 | Property-based roundtrip de-scramble invariant ($A \oplus K \oplus K = A$) | F5, F6 | High |

## Coverage Thresholds
- Tier 1: >= 5 test cases per feature
- Tier 2: >= 5 boundary / corner cases per feature
- Tier 3: Pairwise combinations of key derivation + de-scrambling + framing
- Tier 4: >= 5 realistic workload application scenarios
- Total test cases targeted: >= 70 test cases

**Content**:
I have completed Phase 1 of OpenFlightReader in Rust. All requirements (R1–R5) and acceptance criteria have been 100% satisfied. The full orchestrator handoff report is available at:
`/home/prem/Projects/Flightreader/.agents/teamwork/orchestrator_2/handoff.md`

### Summary of Deliverables & Verification:
1. **R1. Workspace Setup & Core Crate Initialization**:
   - Initialized virtual Cargo workspace at project root (`/home/prem/Projects/Flightreader/Cargo.toml`) with release profile optimizations (`lto = "fat"`, `panic = "abort"`, `opt-level = 3`, `strip = true`).
   - Initialized `crates/flightreader-core` with dependencies (`thiserror = "2.0"`, `byteorder = "1.5"`, `proptest = "1.5"`).
   - Implemented `FlightReaderError` in `crates/flightreader-core/src/error.rs` containing all 11 contextual error variants.
   - Enforced `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` and `#![warn(missing_docs)]` with 0 unsafe blocks.

2. **R2. DJI .txt Header & Version Parser**:
   - Implemented `crates/flightreader-core/src/txt/` (`header.rs`, `version.rs`, `mod.rs`).
   - `TxtHeader::parse` provides zero-allocation slice parsing of DetailsOffset (i64 LE), HeaderLength (i16 LE), Version (u8), Department (u8), ScrambledFlag (u8), 87-byte Reserved block, and optional padding byte.
   - Supports both 100-byte and 101-byte headers with strict validation.
   - `classify_version` accurately categorizes v1 through v14 capabilities (length widths, scramble mechanisms, details block relocation).

3. **R3. CRC64 Keystream Engine & Cyclic XOR De-Scrambler**:
   - Implemented `crates/flightreader-core/src/crypto/` (`crc64.rs`, `xor.rs`, `mod.rs`).
   - ECMA-182 polynomial `0x42F0E1EBA9EA3693` lookup table and `MAGIC_KEY = 1311768467463790320` (`0x123456789ABCDEF0`).
   - Pure register `derive_key` produces bit-for-bit identical 8-byte keys across all 256 seeds and record types (72 reference vectors and full 65,536 keyspace verified with 0 mismatches and 0 collisions).
   - High-performance in-place and slice XOR de-scrambling benchmarked at 1.42 GB/s to 2.48 GB/s (far exceeding the 250 MB/s target).

4. **R4. Basic DJI .DAT Blackbox Framing**:
   - Implemented `crates/flightreader-core/src/dat/` (`frame.rs`, `checksum.rs`, `mod.rs`).
   - Synchronizes on `0x55` magic byte, extracts 9-byte header, and slices payload zero-copy `[9 .. Length - ChecksumLen]`.
   - Dual-seed CRC16-CCITT (`0x3692` / `0xFFFF`) and IEEE 802.3 CRC32 verification.
   - `DatFrameIterator` state machine with monotonic cursor advancement, thoroughly tested against 77-byte noise streams and 50KB pathological streams.

5. **R5. Comprehensive Test Suite & Quality Verification**:
